locator: II.A.2.g.2, printed p. 27, sex and combined counts by year of life. Single-year table II.A.2.g.1, printed pp. 25–26
published_scope: Kingdom of Bavaria including the Palatinate, population present
definition: The published five-year groups and the terminal 101st year of life cover the full 1900 census population. Ages are stored in completed years, so the original first through fifth years correspond to ages 0–4. The original terminal year is exact age 100, with one male and no females. No separate unknown-age row is printed. This panel overlaps the two special age groups on the same page.
uncertainty: Changes in age and sex shares over the 334 days between opening and enumeration are unquantified.

locator: I.B.8, printed p. 7, column 2, Ortsanwesende überhaupt
definition: The 1904 yearbook publishes the 1900 census by age and marital status. This column gives the age counts for both sexes combined, including 6,741 persons of unknown age. The table does not publish a sex cross-tabulation.

locator: Table XXIV, printed p. 114, Prussia row. Cross-check: Prussian yearbook I.B.3 and I.B.8, printed pp. 3 and 7
definition: This partial table transcribes the all-age totals and the published male and female counts below age 15. The all-age totals agree with Prussian yearbook I.B.3. The combined count below age 15 agrees with the sum of completed ages 0 through 14 in I.B.8. The remaining age-by-sex cells in the Italian digitization differ from the Prussian age and sex totals, so this panel retains only the corroborated counts.
opening_residual_label: Age 15 or older or age not reported
opening_method: Subtract the published ages 0–14 from the published all-age count for each sex. Keep this remainder as unknown age. Hold the four census shares in the January 1900 opening balance and use integer largest remainders.
uncertainty: Sex totals and the child counts are observed at the December 1900 census. Ages 15 and above and unreported ages remain combined within each sex. The effect of 334 days between opening and enumeration on the four shares is unquantified.
